title: Highly recommended!!
text: Cristian gave us a wonderful tour! He's very knowledgeable on Barcelona, it's history, and the architecture of this beautiful city. And the car was such a fun ride! Highly recommended tour!! A+++
author: Marina_B

title: Sin par… No better way to enjoy Barcelona…
text: His level of enthusiasm and depth of relevant knowledge was truly amazing.! We are avid travelers…this is one of the best tours ever for us.
author: Lori_F

title: Tour In Style!
text: Cristian’s tour was funny, fun, informative and personal. He took such great care of my group. He welcomed us and our service dog with open arms and thoughtful little gifts. I will be recommending this tour to anyone and everyone who plans on coming to Barcelona. We fully intend on taking this tour every time we come back to visit! Thank you Cristian for an amazing tour of Barcelona!
author: Hannah_C

title: Tuk
text: Roger was our guide, he was very informative and personable.  We really enjoyed seeing Barcelona in the Tuk Tuk.
author: Jane_H

title: Highly recommend
text: What a great tour but an even better tour guide!  His personality shines thru with humor and facts.  I would HIGHLY recommend this tour!
author: Bridget_M

title: Fun vintage tuk tuk, great guide
text: Christian was a wonderful guide and very friendly. He was easy to communicate with on WhatsApp to find each other. The earpiece translator is a little awkward, but it works fine and allows him to be a guide for many nationalities. We got to see a lot, and the vintage tuk tuk was very comfortable and a fun twist on all the other tuk tuks we saw all around. This tour was a good overview of Barcelona. We had a 2 hour tour. I would recommend a longer tour as there is so much to see.
author: jenic658
